title: arango-deployment chart values
description: Values for rendering a database.arangodb.com/v1 ArangoDeployment.

nameOverride.description: Overrides the ArangoDeployment metadata.name (defaults to the Helm release name).

spec.description: Raw ArangoDeployment spec, deep-merged over the generated spec. Any spec field can be set here.

serverGroup.description: Maps 1:1 to the ArangoDeployment ServerGroupSpec. Any ServerGroupSpec field is accepted.

count.description: Number of members in the group.
